code='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    def rotate_cw(a):
        return [list(row) for row in zip(*a[::-1])]
    def rotate_ccw(a):
        return [list(row) for row in zip(*a)][::-1]
    tl = [row[:] for row in grid]
    tr = rotate_cw(grid)
    bl = rotate_ccw(grid)
    br = rotate_cw(rotate_cw(grid))
    return [tl[r] + tr[r] for r in range(n)] + [bl[r] + br[r] for r in range(n)]
'''
